name: cycle-lifecycle
description: Project memory for AI agents — 7 commands for running multi-session projects. State lives in files; /start loads it, /close saves it. Dual-compatible (Codex + Claude).

interface.shortDescription: Run multi-session projects: stage/step position, drift-check, lessons.
interface.longDescription: 7 session-loop skills: cycle-kickoff, cycle-start, cycle-snapshot, cycle-roadmap, cycle-lesson, cycle-lesson-global, cycle-close. Project state lives in files, not in the chat scroll — each session begins with $cycle-start (where we are + one next move) and ends with $cycle-close (a consistent save + a ready commit). The goal: run a project across dozens of sessions without losing context and without burning tokens on one giant thread.
defaultPrompt: $cycle-start — enter a project session (where we are + next move)
$cycle-kickoff — set up a new multi-session project
